title: Comment on multiple items
description: For the items selected in the grid, finds their suggestions and opens one comment thread per suggestion with the message typed by the user. Shows the find, jq, bulk-create pattern in three tasks.

descriptionLocal.fra: Pour les items sélectionnés dans la grille, retrouve leurs suggestions et ouvre un fil de commentaires par suggestion avec le message saisi par l'utilisateur.

tasks.name: data-suggestion-find
tasks.description: Find the suggestions attached to the selected items (the launch context carries the selected item ids in query.value)

tasks.name: json-transform-jq
tasks.description: Build one comment_thread operation per suggestion, keys numbered from 1

inputParameters.queryExpression: .data.message as $msg | { operations: (.data.suggestions | to_entries | map({ key: ((.key + 1) | tostring), element: { object: "comment_thread", targetType: "suggestion", targetId: .value.id, comments: [{ message: $msg }] } })) }

tasks.name: data-comment-thread-create
tasks.description: Create every thread in a single call
